content.title: Chapter 38 - ENVIRONMENT — Sec. 38-304. - Smoking prohibited.
content.summary:
It shall be unlawful for any person to smoke in any public place or sports arena as
               defined in this division or a cigar-tobacco bar as defined in C.R.S. § 25-14-203.
